messages:
maria-p: Quick thread — we need to lock routing + multi-region + tenant isolation priorities for the next planning window. Customers are pushing region pinning + audit trails; some want full isolation. I sketched a 3-tier plan below. feedback?

jasper: +1 on tiers. prefer incremental risk surface reduction rather than big bang.

kevin: Can we define what "region pinning" means operationally? is it soft affinity or hard enforcement with SLA? implementation differs a lot.

maria-p: Proposal: Phase A = affinity + routing audit logs + templates. Phase B = namespace-based soft isolation (quotas, cache namespaces, per-tenant metrics) + cost-aware routing. Phase C = dedicated pools & network isolation for regulated customers.

sophie: We need explicit launch gates per phase. e.g., Phase A gates: 1) region affinity works for 95% pinned requests in canary, 2) no >10% regression on p99 for pinned flows, 3) audit logs for routing decisions available in console.

rahul: Fintech customer asked for audit + egress controls + SLA on pinned routing. We can deliver audit + affinity quick, but SLA requires stronger guarantees. Recommend we surface audit independently so sales can sign agreements earlier.

kevin: Implementation notes: affinity can be a token that pins routing on control-plane state. For soft isolation we must ensure KV cache keys are namespaced or we replicate hot keys across regions. Deterministic fallback rules are critical to avoid oscillation.

jasper: Also propose we ship three supported routing templates only: low-latency, cost-saver, regulated-strict. Templates reduce support surface.

maria-p: Draft sample template (for discussion):
```json
{
  "mode": "regulated-strict",
  "pin": {"regions": ["us-east-1"], "enforce": "sticky"},
  "fallback": {"strategy": "regional-failover", "max_failovers": 1},
  "audit": true
}
```

sophie: Security signoff must be part of acceptance. Phase B acceptance: isolation smoke tests (no cross-tenant KV leakage), perf budget for batching efficiency, and prompt-set quality checks.

kevin: For Phase C we'd need infra estimates: separate GPU pools, VPC endpoints, KMS separation. I'll produce rough cost delta if we decide to accelerate.

maria-p: Rollout plan idea: enable Phase A as an opt-in org flag, run 7-day canary at 5% traffic with eng-oncall monitoring, then 25% if metrics stable for 48h.

rahul: Action items: kevin -> infra delta for Phase C (ETA Tue). jasper -> design doc for deterministic fallback + cache strategy (ETA Fri). sophie -> security checklist and perf criteria (ETA Mon). maria-p -> customer-priority matrix + roadmap slide (ETA Wed).

prod-bot: Reminder: roadmap sync Thu 10:00AM.

maria-p: If no objections I'll fold this into the roadmap doc and share in Thu sync. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
